description: Elixir strings accept backslash-x followed by one or two hex digits, and backslash-x with braces; fz rejects them as unknown escapes. Found by the fz-iqp.5 builder (not re-probed by me). Lexer::read_escape is the one reader. Signal: oracle fixture; diagnostic fixture for a malformed form.
title: Strings accept Elixir's hex escapes
